_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Britax B-Lively Lightweight Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Britax B-Lively — Click'n Go Infant Car Seat Adapter

_priceNote: MSRP $239.99 (Britax/Pish Posh/Albee). GoodBuy Gear open-box $136.99 was sold out at check. Amazon listing carries it — reconfirm live price.

brake.type: single-pedal foot brake engaging both rear wheels

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth-ready (near-flat infinite recline); birth with a Britax/B-Safe infant car seat via Click & Go adapter

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 carriage & stroller standard
safety.certifications: 5-point harness (adjustable slot heights 9.5/12.5/15 in); all-wheel suspension. JPMA certification not confirmed on Britax/retailer pages.
safety.notes: Extra-large front-access storage basket (lb capacity not published). Handle single fixed height; near-flat recline (~24°–55° range).

recall.note: No recall found for the B-Lively. Other Britax models were recalled (2017 B-Agile/BOB Motion Click & Go travel-system car-seat detachment; 2016 B-Ready arm-bar; 2011 B-Nimble brake), but not the B-Lively.

specs.foldType: one-hand quick fold in one motion (pull strap in seat), self-standing
specs.tires: 3-wheel; foam-filled (never-flat) tires with all-wheel spring suspension; front swivel with lock

notes: Lightest full-featured single in this batch (20 lb), one-hand self-standing fold (29 x 23 x 12 in) — the most city/shopping-friendly of the S3 strollers. Clek Liing attaches via Britax's Click & Go Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna adapter (adapter-britax-clickngo): the Liing shares the Maxi-Cosi footprint and Clek's official list names the Click'n Go adapter for the B-Lively. $239.99 MSRP is well under a typical stroller budget.
